narrative_vs_numbers.point: Guidance paints triple‑digit IT‑hardware growth, but actual FY26 revenue rose only ~26% YoY.
Capex targets of >1,100 cr lack supporting data, while borrowings rose to 1,236 cr, hinting higher spend.
Operating cash flow improved to 1,782 cr, matching the narrative of strong cash conversion.

bull: FY26 revenue reached 48,873 cr, up 25% YoY.
Operating cash flow rose to 1,782 cr, 1.08× PAT.
Borrowings increased modestly to 994 cr, D/E stable at 0.21.
bear: IT‑hardware revenue growth far below the promised 3x.
PAT fell 44.9% YoY in Q2 FY27 despite revenue surge.
EBIT margin slipped to 2.2% in Sep 2026, below earlier guidance.
